label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to _____ it and to keep it.
verse: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
note: Work came before the fall, not after it — Adam's first job description was to dress and keep a garden.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou in thy _____ hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
verse: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
note: From the Song of the Sea: God's mercy leads and His strength guides — all the way to His holy habitation.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she made him sleep upon her _____; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
verse: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
note: Modern versions say 'lap'; the KJV has Delilah lull Samson to sleep upon her knees before calling for the barber.

label: Deep Water
prompt: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live _____ with all men.
verse: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
note: Paul's realistic peace clause: 'if it be possible' — you can only control your half of the relationship.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Behold now _____, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verse: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
note: God points Job to 'behemoth,' a grass-eating giant: 'he is the chief of the ways of God' (40:19).
